shown.message:
I've closed `story-repo`#8. I re-worded Outline rev. 23 to match Brief rev. 22 and pushed it.

The Outline now says most of B₂'s width is noise in the cubic curvature estimate, and some price remains with the true curvature. It no longer says the width is "mostly not the price of non-identification", and it states no price of non-identification. The rest of the true-M arm result is as in my last update. The paper (`dev` 252eacd) already says the same.

I'm waiting on the smallest-κ result from `experiment-repo`#12. The Brief hasn't carried it yet, so I'll add it to the Outline once it does. `story-repo`#2 stays open.
